about: The games that run because of an improvement: one of the Wine modules MacGameFix installs into a CrossOver app or a NotProton runner, not a fix in the game's folder or prefix. A game is added after it was played, by us or by someone who reported it, never from what it should do. A report from someone else stays 'reported' until we play it. A game that also needs a fix of its own names it in 'fix' (docs/fixes/games/<fix>.json).

rosetta-copy-protection.name: Copy protection under Rosetta
rosetta-copy-protection.summary: The Intel side's ntdll.so (engine patches 0017, 0018 and 0019): Rosetta's x86 CPU made to look more like a real one to copy protection such as Denuvo. The game's code is not touched.

dualsense.name: DualSense controllers
dualsense.summary: The DualSense's haptics, trigger effects and audio output, on a cable and over Bluetooth. Its games are in docs/vibration.json.

games.name: Persona 4 Golden
games.description: Plays at about 60 fps with no launch options. It used to crash about 12 s in: Rosetta skipped a cpuid that Denuvo had just decrypted in place (patch 0019).

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.description: Passes Denuvo with the improvement; its own fix asks for the CPU bits and makes the menu video play.

tests.notes: Played for over 40 minutes, in full screen with macOS Game Mode on. TSR with D3DM_ENABLE_METALFX=0.

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.description: Runs with the improvement alone, no fix and no launch option.

tests.notes: Reported working, with screenshots, without changes beyond MacGameFix's improvement.

games.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer
games.description: Runs with the improvement alone, no fix and no launch option, since the Wine modules of 2026-11-03 (engine patch 0020); earlier modules showed the CPU bits its Denuvo checks for only when the launch options asked.

tests.notes: Reported working, with screenshots: racing at about 80 fps at 1512x827 with MetalFX temporal scaling.

Got past Denuvo and started with no launch option once 0020 was in the runner. With the modules before it, it died before its first frame unless NOTPROTON_ENV_WINE_ROSETTA_CPUID7_OR=01800000,00400000 was in its launch options.
